limits: Independent software peer only; no physical printer/paper or vendor interoperability certification.
Only the eight retained sends are asserted; no native listener/SCP, printer registry, capabilities, Job N-GET, timeout/retry or other unobserved UI action is inferred.
Successful flows release normally. Injected N-SET failure and rejected LUT clean up with successful session deletion then A-ABORT; do not describe these two as normal releases.
Session cleanup wire request/response is proven. The simple peer records operations; durable resource reclamation or actual physical completion is outside its model.
Grayscale12 command includes raw mode and render bit-depth8; raw preserves original 16 allocated/12 stored pixel samples on wire, as independently verified.
Annotation first trailing space is indistinguishable from DICOM trailing padding semantically; exact expected UTF8/ASCII bytes including original space plus one even pad are checked.
Copied console was obtained by the native owner and pasted into a nonexecuted Import sheet for complete AX capture; report uses it as copied output corroborated by wire, not as new command execution.
This audit does not independently repeat source/app identity checks; see native-resume-identity and owner execution record for packaged provenance.

standards_basis.meaning: Film Session N-DELETE covers session hierarchy including referenced images/annotations/LUTs; peer reclamation not asserted.
